name: Kubernetes
description: Shows a Kubernetes cluster (k3s, kubeadm, RKE2, Talos, microk8s, ...) as hosts and guests: the nodes as hosts with their address and Ready state, the pods as guests of the node they run on, with namespace, workload, image, ports, restarts and readiness. Read-only: it only lists nodes and pods with a service account that may do nothing else. Pods that finished (Completed jobs) are left out.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
